questions.question: Explain the effect on the accounting equation of: (a) paying wages R3 000; (b) buying equipment R5 200 by EFT; (c) repaying R1 500 of a loan (no interest); (d) the owner's drawings R2 500. Give reasons.
questions.expected_answer: (a) A −3 000 (bank); OE −3 000 (expense incurred); L no effect. (b) A +5 200 (equipment) and −5 200 (bank): total assets unchanged; OE and L no effect. (c) A −1 500 (bank); L −1 500 (loan decreased); OE no effect. (d) A −2 500 (bank); OE −2 500 (drawings); L no effect.

questions.question: April: receipts were current income R18 650, capital R10 000, rent income R2 500 and interest income R180; payments were expenses R17 625, drawings R2 500 and equipment R5 200. Calculate the change in bank, the change in total assets, the change in owner's equity and the profit.
Explain why the April profit differs from the increase in the bank balance, and reconcile the two figures.
questions.expected_answer: Bank changes with all receipts and payments; profit includes only income and expenses. Capital (R10 000) increased bank but is not income; drawings (R2 500) and equipment (R5 200) decreased bank but are not expenses. Profit 3 705 + 10 000 − 2 500 − 5 200 = R6 005 = increase in bank.
